description.en: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.
description.zh-CN: 使用ARC零件搭建你的狩猎战利品展示架，以此巧妙驳斥那些质疑你上层冒险传奇的人。

description.en: The earthbound machines rolling and trudging across the surface, forcing Raiders to watch their every step.
description.zh-CN: 在地表横行霸道的陆行机械，迫使奇袭者们时刻保持警惕。

description.en: The airborne machines dominating the skies, raining peril down upon unsuspecting Raiders.
description.zh-CN: 主宰苍穹的空中机械，随时准备猎杀毫无防备的奇袭者。

description.en: A clear escalation of topside dangers, these machines have doled out severe punishments to overconfident Raiders.
description.zh-CN: 这些机器是上层危险逐步升级的代言人，那些过于自信的奇袭者都遭受过它们的严厉惩罚。

description.en: The vicious threats leaving behind a trail of downed Raiders; dominating their surroundings with tenacity and grit.
description.zh-CN: 凶残的敌人以顽强与悍勇主宰着自己的领地，所过之处留下遍地的奇袭者尸骸。

description.en: The colossal foes making the earth tremble, and the epitome of big-game hunting.
description.zh-CN: 那些令大地震颤的庞然巨物，象征着大型狩猎的终极挑战。

description.en: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.
description.zh-CN: 远征的旅程危机重重。为了前往锈带之外的未知区域，你的奇袭者将携带所有财产。作为回报，在下一次远征出发之前，你的下一名奇袭者将会获得独特的优势。

description.en: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan
description.zh-CN: 构建远征队的基础结构和框架

description.en: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems
description.zh-CN: 连接导线、通风系统和关键的能源系统

description.en: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout
description.zh-CN: 建造墙壁和顶板，安装核心系统，规划内部布局

description.en: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches
description.zh-CN: 添加货舱、工作台、基础配套设施以及个人特色

description.en: Loading the caravan with vital supplies. Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition
description.zh-CN: 为远征队装入必要物资。要为远征做好完全的准备，战斗装备、生存装备、口粮以及维修材料是必不可少的

description.en:
Your caravan is fully stocked and your Raider is ready to depart on the Expedition!

Upon departure, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to the Expedition, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.
description.zh-CN:
你的远征队已经装满了货物，你的奇袭者已经准备好出发踏上远征之旅！

在出发时，你的奇袭者储物箱内的所有剩余物品都将贡献给本次远征，而你的下一名奇袭者则可以根据这些物品的总价值，获得最多5个技能点。

description.en: Conduct research, gather supplies, and safeguard the construction site to carve out your own small corner of Topside.
description.zh-CN: 开展研究、收集物资、保护建筑工地，在上层开辟属于你自己的一方天地。

description.en: To build Outposts that last, it is wise to draw inspiration from what few structures are still standing.
description.zh-CN: 要建造经久耐用的哨站，从现存的少数建筑中汲取灵感是明智之举。

localizations.en: To build Outposts that last, it is wise to draw inspiration from what few structures are still standing.
localizations.zh-CN: 要建造经久耐用的哨站，从现存的少数建筑中汲取灵感是明智之举。

description.en: Collect advanced materials to ensure your Outpost is resilient even in the face of an ever-looming threat.
description.zh-CN: 收集高级材料，让你的哨站即便在步步紧逼的威胁面前也坚不可摧。

description.en: Distract and destroy ARC machines to allow for the construction efforts to take place undisturbed.
description.zh-CN: 牵制并摧毁ARC机器，保障建造工作顺利进行。

localizations.en: Distract and destroy ARC machines to allow for the construction efforts to take place undisturbed.
localizations.zh-CN: 牵制并摧毁ARC机器，保障建造工作顺利进行。

description.en: Engineers from the Ferrovia neighborhood of Toledo are revered for their technical prowess… And their willingness to go beyond standard safety measures. Rumor has it that they’re working with Apollo on a very experimental piece of “transportation” to take us where the Tubes can't reach. He’s requested assistance from Raiders who understand schematics, and can keep their heads down.
description.zh-CN: 托雷多城费罗维亚街区的工程师们凭借精湛技艺受人敬仰……同时他们也敢于突破常规安全规范。有传闻称，他们正与阿波罗合作研发一款极具试验性质的“运载装置”，以前往暗道系统无法抵达的区域。他向精通图纸研究、行事低调的奇袭者寻求协助。

description.en: Research High-Altitude Mechanics
description.zh-CN: 研究高空机械原理

description.en: Begin Ignition Tests
description.zh-CN: 启动点火测试

description.en: Implement Landing Capabilities
description.zh-CN: 增设降落功能

description.en: Final Tweaks
description.zh-CN: 最终调试

description.en: Unrecognizable noise has started flooding Shani's radars, and she can't pinpoint the origin of these phantom targets. Raider assistance is needed to improve antennas on the surface, and track ARC behavior for any changes.
description.zh-CN: 萨尼的雷达上开始出现大规划未知噪点，她无法准确定位幻影目标的来源。需要奇袭者协助升级地表的天线装置，并追踪ARC的行为变化。

description.en: Upgrade antennas found on top of any Cargo Elevator
description.zh-CN: 升级任意货运电梯顶部的天线

localizations.en: Upgrade antennas found on top of any Cargo Elevator
localizations.zh-CN: 升级任意货运电梯顶部的天线

name.en: Test ARC Parts for Irregular Behavior

description.en: Deal damage to ARC enemies using Wasp Drivers, Pop Triggers and Leaper Pulse Units
description.zh-CN: 使用“黄蜂”引擎、“爆爆”触发器和“跳跃者”脉冲单元对ARC敌人造成伤害

description.en: Destroy ARC enemies using fire damage, energy damage, and launcher ammo
description.zh-CN: 使用火焰伤害、能量伤害和发射器弹药消灭ARC敌人

localizations.en: Destroy ARC enemies using fire damage, energy damage, and launcher ammo
localizations.zh-CN: 使用火焰伤害、能量伤害和发射器弹药消灭ARC敌人

description.en: The phantom targets Shani was tracking have a source: some Wasps are exhibiting patterns we've never seen before. They seem frantic.
description.zh-CN: 萨尼追踪的幻影目标已有了源头：部分“黄蜂”表现出前所未见的行为模式，看起来焦躁失控。

name.en: Bring In Glitched Wasp Parts for Testing
name.zh-CN: 带回故障“黄蜂”零件用于测试

description.en: Collect glitched Wasp parts
description.zh-CN: 收集故障“黄蜂”零件

name.en: Perform Final Tests on Glitched Wasp Parts
name.zh-CN: 对故障“黄蜂”零件进行最终测试

description.en: Collect glitched Wasp parts
description.zh-CN: 收集故障“黄蜂”零件

description.en: Deal damage to any flying ARC using Fireworks
description.zh-CN: 使用烟花对任意空中ARC造成伤害
